AddText.description: Appends text to the end of the cell content.

params.description: The text to append.
params.name: text

GetBackgroundColor.description: Returns the background color of the current table cell.

GetClassType.description: Returns the type of the ApiTableCell class.

GetNext.description: Returns the next cell if exists.

returns.description: returns null if cell is last.

GetParentRow.description: Returns a parent row of the current cell.

returns.description: returns null if parent row doesn't exist.

GetParentTable.description: Returns a parent table of the current cell.

returns.description: returns null if parent table doesn't exist.

GetPrevious.description: Returns the previous cell if exists.

returns.description: returns null is cell is first.

GetRowIndex.description: Returns an index of the parent row.

GetText.description: Returns the inner text of the current table cell.

params.description: Options for formatting the returned text.
params.name: pr

params.description: Defines if the resulting string will include numbering or not.
params.name: pr_Numbering

params.description: Defines if the resulting string will include mathematical expressions or not.
params.name: pr_Math

params.description: Defines how the table cell separator will be specified in the resulting string.
params.name: pr_TableCellSeparator

params.description: Defines how the table row separator will be specified in the resulting string.
params.name: pr_TableRowSeparator

params.description: Defines how the paragraph separator will be specified in the resulting string.
params.name: pr_ParaSeparator

params.description: Defines how the tab will be specified in the resulting string.
params.name: pr_TabSymbol

params.description: Defines how the line separator will be specified in the resulting string.
params.name: pr_NewLineSeparator

SetBackgroundColor.description: Sets the background color of the current cell.

params.description: If not passed, the background color will be cleared (see arguments below for RGB triplet form).
params.name: color

SetCellBorderBottom.description: Sets the border which shall be displayed at the bottom of the current table cell.

params.description: The width of the current border.
params.name: borderWidth

params.description: The color or pattern used to fill the current border.
params.name: fill

SetCellBorderLeft.description: Sets the border which shall be displayed at the left of the current table cell.

params.description: The width of the current border.
params.name: borderWidth

params.description: The color or pattern used to fill the current border.
params.name: fill

SetCellBorderRight.description: Sets the border which shall be displayed at the right of the current table cell.

params.description: The width of the current border.
params.name: borderWidth

params.description: The color or pattern used to fill the current border.
params.name: fill

SetCellBorderTop.description: Sets the border which shall be displayed at the top of the current table cell.

params.description: The width of the current border.
params.name: borderWidth

params.description: The color or pattern used to fill the current border.
params.name: fill

SetCellMarginBottom.description:
Specifies an amount of space which shall be left between the bottom extent of the cell contents and the border
of a specific individual table cell within a table.

params.description: The cell margin. If this value is `null`, the default margin is used.otherwise override the table cell bottom margin with specified value for the current cell.
params.name: margin

SetCellMarginLeft.description:
Specifies an amount of space which shall be left between the left extent of the current cell contents and the
left edge border of a specific individual table cell within a table.

params.description: The cell margin. If this value is `null`, the default margin is used.otherwise override the table cell left margin with specified value for the current cell.
params.name: margin

SetCellMarginRight.description:
Specifies an amount of space which shall be left between the right extent of the current cell contents and the
right edge border of a specific individual table cell within a table.

params.description: The cell margin. If this value is `null`, the default margin is used.otherwise override the table cell right margin with specified value for the current cell.
params.name: margin

SetCellMarginTop.description:
Specifies an amount of space which shall be left between the top extent of the current cell contents and the
top edge border of a specific individual table cell within a table.

params.description: The cell margin. If this value is `null`, the default margin is used.otherwise override the table cell top margin with specified value for the current cell.
params.name: margin

SetColumnBackgroundColor.description: Sets the background color to all cells in the column containing the current cell.

params.description: If not passed, the background color will be cleared.
params.name: color

SetShd.description: Specifies the shading which shall be applied to the extents of the current table cell.

params.description: The shading type or fill to apply.
params.name: shadingType

params.description: Red color component value.
params.name: r

params.description: Green color component value.
params.name: g

params.description: Blue color component value.
params.name: b

SetShd.signature: SetShd(shadingType: ShdType | ApiFill, r: number, g: number, b: number): boolean

SetText.description:
Replaces all content of the current table cell with the specified text,
preserving the formatting of the first paragraph.

params.description: The text to set.
params.name: text

SetTextDirection.description: Specifies the direction of the text flow for the current table cell.

params.description: The text flow direction.
params.name: textDirection

SetVerticalAlign.description: Specifies the vertical alignment for text within the current table cell.

params.description: The vertical alignment type.
params.name: verticalAlign

SetWidth.description: Specifies the preferred width for this cell.

params.description: The type of the width value.
params.name: sType

params.description: The table width value measured in positive integers.
params.name: nValue
